five_step_revenue_walkthrough.title: Gatekeeper Subscription — Paid Membership Tiers & 92.9% Renewal Lock-In
verified_figures: 76.2M paid members (63.7M Gold Star + 12.5M Business), 60.6M household cards = 136.8M total cardholders
35.4M paid Executive members (46.5% of paid base) generating 73.3% of worldwide {Net Sales}
92.9% U.S./Canada and 90.5% worldwide renewal rates
$2,501M Deferred membership fees liability amortized ratably over 12 months under ASC 606
$2,804M Executive 2% reward recognized as direct contra-revenue reduction against {Net Sales}
Sept 1, 2024 U.S./Canada fee increase ($60->$65 base, $120->$130 Executive, $1,000->$1,250 cap, +$370M 2-yr lift)

five_step_revenue_walkthrough.title: Concentrated Purchasing Scale — <4,000 Warehouse SKUs & Kirkland Signature
verified_figures: <4,000 active warehouse SKUs across 890 clubs (130.9M sq ft), channeling >$62M annual volume per average SKU
Note 11 category disaggregation: $101,463M Foods & Sundries (40.65%), $63,973M Non-Foods (25.63%), $49,969M Warehouse Ancillary (20.02%), $34,220M Fresh Foods (13.71%)
~30%+ Kirkland Signature private-label penetration (+36 bps core merchandise margin expansion in FY2024)
31.9M sq ft cross-docked depot network delivering direct-to-floor pallets

five_step_revenue_walkthrough.title: High-Frequency Trip Magnets — 719 Gas Stations, Ancillary Services & Omnichannel Logistics
verified_figures: 719 member-only gas stations generating ~12% of consolidated {Net Sales} (~$30B, +1% gallon volume in FY2024)
Pharmacy (+3% YoY ancillary dollar growth leader), Optical, Hearing Aids, Tire Installation, and $1.50 Hot Dog & Soda Food Court
E-Commerce (~7% of net sales / ~$17.5B, +16% comparable growth across 9,000-10,000 online SKUs) and Digitally Originated Sales (~9% / ~$22.5B)
Costco Logistics big-and-bulky fulfillment, Costco Next, Costco Travel, and Citibank co-branded Visa royalties & February reward certificates

five_step_revenue_walkthrough.title: Disciplined Pricing & Negative Working Capital — The 10.92% {Gross Margin Ceiling} & 104.15% Supplier Float
verified_figures: {Net Sales} ($249,625M) - Merchandise costs ($222,358M) = $27,267M Merchandise Gross Margin (10.92% {Gross Margin Ceiling})
Lean 9.14% SG&A ($22,810M, inclusive of warehouse preopening costs per Note 1)
12.60x average inventory turnover (~28.97 DIO vs. ~31.88 DPO)
$19,421M Accounts payable / $18,647M Merchandise inventories = 104.15% supplier inventory coverage (+$774M excess cash float)

five_step_revenue_walkthrough.title: The {Operating Income Flywheel} — Converting $4,828M of Fees into 52.00% of Consolidated Operating Profit
verified_figures: $4,457M Merchandise Operating Contribution (48.00% of OpInc, 1.79% of Net Sales) + $4,828M {Membership Fees} (52.00% of OpInc) = $9,285M Consolidated Operating Income (3.65% operating margin)
-$169M Interest Expense + $624M Interest Income & Other, Net = $9,740M Income Before Taxes
-$2,373M Income Tax Provision (24.36% effective tax rate) = $7,367M Consolidated Net Income ($16.56 diluted EPS)
